yt.title: 23 people, {c_p} chance two share a birthday #Shorts
yt.description:
Computed exactly: the probability that at least two of {c_n} people share a birthday is {c_p}. With {c_n2} people it passes 99.9%. Assumes 365 equally likely birthdays.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Put twenty three people in a room. The chance that two of them share a birthday is over fifty percent.

scenes.label: chance two of {c_n} people share a birthday
scenes.narration: We computed it exactly. It is {c_p_say} percent.
The trick is pairs, not people. Twenty three people make {c_pairs_say} pairs, and every pair is a chance to match. With seventy people, the chance is {c_p2_say} percent.
